disciplinary_grounds.description: Attempting to procure a license by bribery or fraudulent misrepresentations
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Attempting to procure a license to practice electrical contracting or to work as a master electrician or journeyman electrician by bribery or fraudulent misrepresentations.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Being convicted or found guilty of a crime directly relating to the practice of electrical contracting or ability to work as an electrician
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Being convicted or found guilty, regardless of adjudication, of a crime in any jurisdiction which directly relates to the practice of electrical contracting, working as a journeyman electrician, or the ability to practice electrical contracting or to work as a master electrician or journeyman electrician.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Making or filing a false report or record, or willfully failing to file required reports
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Making or filing a report or record which the licensee knows to be false, willfully failing to file a report or record required by state or federal law, willfully impeding or obstructing such filing, or inducing another person to impede or obstruct such filing.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Being found guilty of fraud, deceit, negligence, incompetency, or misconduct in the practice of electrical contracting
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Being found guilty of fraud or deceit or of negligence, incompetency, or misconduct in the practice of electrical contracting or working as a master electrician or journeyman electrician.
